hero.headline:
Your own AI workspace,
running on your hardware.
hero.lede: Odysseus is a self-hosted interface for talking to language models — chat, autonomous agents, tools, model serving, email, research, and more. Local-first, privacy-first, and no telemetry. Just you and your models.

how.heading: Odysseus is everything I hate, just making it tolerable.
how.p1: I started working on the Odysseus project because running local AI felt fun — a step into the future. But the options to actually engage with LLMs felt like taking steps back. Where were features like Memory, Deep Research, Agents, and just basic integrations?!
how.p2: So I started building my own, for fun — and eventually figured it might be fun to share what I built for myself with others. Doesn't work for you? Well… it runs great on my hardware.

email.accounts_sub: Configure one or more IMAP/SMTP accounts. The default account is used when nothing else is selected.
email.writing_style_ph: e.g. I write emails in this style. I don't use exclamation marks. I sign emails with: ...
email.writing_style_sub: AI-extracted from your sent emails. Used when AI drafts replies.

email_form.default_hint: Use this account whenever no specific account is chosen.
email_form.default_note: Used when nothing else is selected
email_form.email_hint: Your email address. Used as the From: header on outgoing mail and as the display label when Name is blank.
email_form.imap_host_hint: Your IMAP server, e.g. imap.gmail.com, imap.migadu.com, a LAN host, or a Tailscale IP for Dovecot.
email_form.imap_pass_hint: Your IMAP login password. Use an app-specific password if your provider requires 2FA (Gmail, iCloud, etc.).
email_form.imap_pass_hint2: For Gmail, iCloud, and Yahoo: paste your App Password (NOT your normal account password — those are blocked for IMAP). For Migadu, Fastmail, Outlook, etc.: your regular mailbox password works.
email_form.imap_port_hint: 993 for IMAPS (most providers), 143 for plain or STARTTLS. Local servers often use a custom port like 31143.
email_form.imap_user_hint2: Yes — your full email address goes here too (e.g. you@gmail.com). Same as the Email field above for almost every provider.
email_form.name: Name
email_form.name_hint: Optional label for this account (e.g. “Work” or “Personal”). Leave blank to use the email address.
email_form.need_name_or_email: Need at least a Name or Email
email_form.note_gmail_body: Your regular Google password won't work for IMAP. Generate a 16-character App Password (requires 2-Step Verification enabled) and paste it as the Password.
email_form.note_icloud_body: Sign in to your Apple ID, go to Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords, and generate one (requires 2FA on your Apple ID).
email_form.note_yahoo_body: Generate an App Password from Yahoo Account Security (requires 2-Step Verification enabled) and paste it as the Password.
email_form.provider_hint: Pick a known provider to auto-fill the IMAP and SMTP host/port. Choose Custom to type your own.
email_form.same_as_imap_hint: Use the IMAP username and password for SMTP too (this is right for almost every provider). Turn off to enter separate SMTP credentials.
email_form.same_as_imap_hint2: Use the IMAP username and password for SMTP too (right for almost every provider). Turn off to enter separate SMTP credentials.
email_form.saved_notice: Email account saved. Go to Settings > Email for writing style, auto-tagging, spam triage, reminders, and reply settings.
email_form.smtp_host_hint: Your outgoing-mail server, e.g. smtp.gmail.com, smtp.migadu.com. Leave blank to make this account read-only.
email_form.smtp_host_hint2: Your outgoing-mail server, e.g. smtp.gmail.com. Leave blank to make this account read-only.
email_form.smtp_pass_hint: Your SMTP password — often the same as your IMAP password.
email_form.smtp_port_hint: 465 for SSL/SMTPS, 587 for STARTTLS. 25 is usually blocked by ISPs.
email_form.smtp_user_hint: Usually the same as your IMAP username (your email address).
email_form.starttls_hint: Turn ON for port 143/587 to upgrade plain to TLS. Turn OFF for port 993 (IMAPS — already encrypted) or a local server with no TLS configured.

integrations.api_key_hint: The secret token the service issued you (generated in its admin panel / settings). Used to prove your identity on each request. Required for any Auth mode except None.
integrations.auth_hint: How this service expects the credential to be sent. Bearer = sends "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_KEY" (most modern APIs, ntfy, OpenAI-style). Header = sends YOUR_KEY verbatim under a header name you choose (Miniflux uses X-Auth-Token). Basic = HTTP basic auth (user:pass). None = the API is open / no auth.
integrations.connections_sub: All external service connections in one place.
integrations.header_hint: The HTTP header name the key goes under (Miniflux: X-Auth-Token; most others: Authorization). Only used when Auth = Header.
